parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ query: "query($from: DateTime) { transcripts(fromDate: $from, limit: 50) { id date } }", variables: { from: $now.minus({ days: $('Settings').first().json.days }).toISO() } }) }}

parameters.jsonInput: ={{ JSON.stringify({ tools: [{ tool_slug: 'GOOGLEDRIVE_FIND_FILE', account: $('Settings').first().json.drive_account, arguments: { q: "name contains 'Notes by Gemini' and mimeType = 'application/vnd.google-apps.document' and trashed = false and createdTime > '" + $now.minus({ days: $('Settings').first().json.days }).toUTC().toISO({ suppressMilliseconds: true, includeOffset: false }) + "'", fields: 'files(id,name,createdTime)', pageSize: 50 } }], sync_response_to_workbench: false, thought: '2brain meetings import' }) }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ query: "query($id: String!) { transcript(id: $id) { id title date duration transcript_url organizer_email participants meeting_attendees { displayName email name } sentences { speaker_name text start_time } } }", variables: { id: $json.id } }) }}

parameters.jsonInput: ={{ JSON.stringify({ tools: [{ tool_slug: 'GOOGLEDRIVE_EXPORT_GOOGLE_WORKSPACE_FILE', account: $('Settings').first().json.drive_account, arguments: { fileId: $json.doc.id, mimeType: 'text/plain' } }], sync_response_to_workbench: false, thought: '2brain meetings import' }) }}
